verses.en: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
verses.pt: Das profundezas clamo a ti, ó Senhor.
verses.en_web: Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up.> Out of the deep have I sent up my cry to you, O Lord.

verses.en: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.pt: Senhor, escuta a minha voz; estejam os teus ouvidos atentos à voz das minhas súplicas.
verses.en_web: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
verses.en_bbe: Lord, let my voice come before you: let your ears be awake to the voice of my prayer.

verses.en: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
verses.pt: Se tu, Senhor, observares as iniqüidades, Senhor, quem subsistirá?
verses.en_web: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
verses.en_bbe: O Jah, if you took note of every sin, who would go free?

verses.en: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.pt: Mas contigo está o perdão, para que sejas temido.
verses.en_web: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
verses.en_bbe: But there is forgiveness with you, so that you may be feared.

verses.en: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.pt: Aguardo ao Senhor; a minha alma o aguarda, e espero na sua palavra.
verses.en_web: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
verses.en_bbe: I am waiting for the Lord, my soul is waiting for him, and my hope is in his word.

verses.en: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
verses.pt: A minha alma anseia pelo Senhor, mais do que os guardas pelo romper da manhã, sim, mais do que os guardas pela manhã.
verses.en_web: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning; more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.en_bbe: My soul is watching for the Lord more than those who are watching for the morning; yes, more than the watchers for the morning.

verses.en: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.pt: Espera, ó Israel, no Senhor! pois com o Senhor há benignidade, e com ele há copiosa redenção;
verses.en_web: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for with Yahweh there is loving kindness. With him is abundant redemption.
verses.en_bbe: O Israel, have hope in the Lord; for with the Lord is mercy and full salvation.

verses.en: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.pt: e ele remirá a Israel de todas as suas iniqüidades.
verses.en_web: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
verses.en_bbe: And he will make Israel free from all his sins.
